verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator syncs user data (verification codes) to a Google Account, so a privacy question about AI-training use of that data is fair to ask. The evidence pack has no documentation of an AI-training opt-out or any policy on training use. The 'Use without an account' local-only mode is an adjacent control, not a training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
